title: GAO-22-104746 — Federal Response to SolarWinds and Microsoft Exchange Incidents
description: Case Study 005 · U.S. Government Accountability Office. Reviews the federal response to two incidents. Use the SolarWinds-specific findings when tracing this case.

title: CISA Emergency Directive 21-01 — Mitigate SolarWinds Orion Code Compromise
description: Case Study 005 · CISA’s directive set required federal mitigations. Direct access could not be verified in this audit. The GAO report in this collection corroborates issuance and summarizes the directive.

title: Department of Justice Statement on SolarWinds Update
description: Case Study 005 · DOJ reported that about 3% of its Microsoft 365 mailboxes may have been accessed. This figure describes potential access. The statement gives no confirmed extraction count.

title: CMS — Health Care Claim or Equivalent Encounter Information
description: Case Study 006 · CMS explains electronic claim submission standards, including X12 837 for medical claims and NCPDP D.0 for retail pharmacy claims. Payment system reference.

title: CMS — Electronic Funds Transfer
description: Case Study 006 · CMS explains how Medicare sends electronic claim payments to a provider’s financial institution. Payment system reference for the settlement stage.
